businesses.business: Cactus, Inc. wellhead and pressure control equipment

offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and rents wellhead and pressure control systems for oil and gas wells. Sells to exploration and production operators and provides flowback services at well sites.

primary_products.value: wellheads; frac trees; valves; pressure control equipment

primary_services.value: flowback services; pressure control rental crews; well-site support

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production operators, oilfield service companies

end_markets.value: oil and gas exploration and production; oilfield services

revenue_model.value: product sales: wellheads, frac trees and valves sold to producers; rental or leasing: pressure control equipment rented for well completions; service fees: flowback and well-site services billed per job
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds wellheads and valves, sold to oil and gas producers; service provider: runs pressure control and flowback crews at well sites for operators

geography_served.value: North America: US oil basins such as the Permian, Eagle Ford and Bakken, plus Canada

specialization.value: related lines: wellheads, pressure control equipment, valves and flowback services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to exploration and production operators; own locations: manufacturing and service yards in US oil basins

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: well-control equipment safety standards and environmental rules for flowback, overseen by state oil and gas regulators and EPA
